name: Cherokee County, IA
findings: Cherokee County has 59 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Cherokee County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 7 social and fraternal organizations here list public events, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.
